question: What all courses and programs are offered at GNDEC? List all B.Tech, BBA, BCA, B.Com, B.Voc, B.Arch, MBA, MCA, M.Tech, and PhD programs.
answer:
Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College (GNDEC) offers a wide variety of Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate (PG), and Doctoral (Ph.D.) programs across various disciplines.

### Undergraduate Programs (UG)
1. **B.Tech.** (Computer Science and Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Information Technology)
2. **B.Tech. (Lateral Entry)**
3. **B.Architecture (B.Arch.)**
4. **BBA** (Bachelor of Business Administration)
5. **BCA** (Bachelor of Computer Applications)
6. **B.Com. (Entrepreneurship)**
7. **B.VoC. (Interior Design)**

### Postgraduate Programs (PG)
1. **MBA** (Master of Business Administration)
2. **MCA** (Master of Computer Applications)
3. **M.Tech.** (Postgraduate M.Tech courses on regular and part-time basis)

### Doctoral Programs
1. **Ph.D.** (in Engineering Branches under QIP and autonomous status)
